play.rationale: To clear the online sell-by breach of 55 units of Rusk 400G at Dark store 03, we propose a bundle play with Butter 400G at a bundle price of 66. This play targets 446 customers across high-affinity segments. The expected outcome is to clear 37.73 units, recovering 1496.37 INR (do_nothing_inr of 1842.5 plus play_net_inr of -346.13). This beats a blanket markdown by 539.83 INR (blanket_markdown_inr of 885.96 plus play_net_inr of -346.13). A coupon alternative was rejected due to lower expected margin.
